entities.summary: María Stella Márquez de Araneta, often styled as Madame Stella de Araneta and also known as Stella Marquez-Araneta, is a Colombian-Filipino pageant director and beauty queen. She grew up in Tumaco, Cali, Bogotá, New York City and Los Angeles, and moved back to Colombia, where she became a pageant titleholder. As Miss Colombia, she was crowned as the first Miss International in 1960.
